sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
**Exercise 1 — Add a "review" command.** Add a conditional edge: if `user_input` starts with "review", skip the `add_note` node and go straight to a new `summarize_node` that prints a markdown-formatted summary of all categories. Otherwise, follow the normal flow.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

Add a `route_after_input(state) -> str` function that returns `"summarize"` or `"add_note"` based on `state["user_input"].lower().startswith("review")`. Use `builder.add_conditional_edges(START, route_after_input)`. The summarize node writes to `state["response"]` and then edges to END.
</details>

**Exercise 2 — Cross-session summary.** At the end of the Daily Reflection bot's main, add a "weekly summary" call that loads the histories from sessions `morning-2025-03-11` through `morning-2025-03-15` and feeds all of them into a single LLM call to produce a week-in-review.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

Iterate over `SESSIONS.items()`, filter by session id prefix, and concatenate `"\n".join(m.content for m in history.messages)` per session. Build a `HumanMessage` with the joined transcript and pass it to a fresh `ChatPromptTemplate` asking for a weekly summary.
</details>

**Exercise 3 — Persist to SQLite.** Replace `MemorySaver` with `SqliteSaver` from `langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite`. Verify that restarting the Python process and using the same `thread_id` rehydrates state.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

`pip install langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite`, then `from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver` and `with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string("notes.db") as memory: graph = builder.compile(checkpointer=memory)`. The rest of the code is unchanged.
</details>
